versions.changelog:
poly-daily-reading v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generates a daily, deduplicated reading list for Guillaume from curated AI/dev/culture sources.
- Bounded search space per category; deduplication leverages both Obsidian history and a read-status JSON cache.
- Outputs structured Obsidian markdown; integrates with Mission Control for ingestion and status updates.
- Includes workflows for weekly and yearly archiving, with automated cleanup.
- Designed for automation via cron or on-demand trigger.
